servers.sheet.s3EndpointMoveHelp: Did the server move? Type its new endpoint. Every bucket under this key comes along, with its favourites, open tabs, and saved secret access key.
servers.sheet.addressMoveHelp: Did the server move? Type its new address. Its favourites, open tabs, and saved password come along.
servers.sheet.smbAddressMoveHelp: Did the server move? Type its new address. Its shares and saved password come along, and each share’s favourites and open tabs follow it the first time it opens there.
